note: Evince main toolbar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for document navigation and view controls (e.g., Back, Forward, Zoom, View)
Document viewer split pane -- renders operator-defined sidebar controls (thumbnails/outline toggles) and status bar; subtracts the document frame which contains the user-supplied PDF content
Evince sidebar action buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for document actions (e.g., Print, Save, Copy, Find, Properties)
